visual.general_description: Grayscale ultrasound sector with colour Doppler overlay showing a rounded fluid-filled structure with a thick wall, a caliper line, a white asterisk and a white arrow.
visual.detailed_description: Fan-shaped ultrasound with a green-outlined colour Doppler box covering a rounded dark structure with a thick echogenic wall. Red, blue and orange colour-flow patches lie along the wall, mainly at its upper left, upper right and lower edge. A thin orange horizontal caliper line crosses the dark lumen with printed text "L: 28.08mm" and "Winkel: 87.57°" to the right. A white asterisk sits just above and right of the structure outside the wall, and a white arrow points at the lower wall. Top left shows a vertical colour velocity scale printed from "10cm/s" to "-10cm/s" and "Voluson E8" in yellow; a left ruler is labelled "30 mm"; a small inset thumbnail of the whole fetal scan is at the bottom left; "W/C: 256/127" is printed at the bottom left. No calendar dates or names are visible.

Grey echogenic tissue is at the right edge. Top left shows "Voluson E8" in yellow and a vertical grayscale bar with yellow ticks; an inset thumbnail of the whole scan with a yellow outline is at the bottom left. No calipers, numbers, calendar dates or names are visible.
